From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: ZenWell SOC 2 & Security Follow-up / Audit Evidence and Next Steps

Hi Laura / Tom ,

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we're aligned as you start the vendor security review:

Summary of pain & goals
- You need SOC 2 Type II evidence (in-progress report + controls mapping) for vendors that process PHI-adjacent metadata.
- Audit log retention and exportability are must-haves for your security and compliance workflows (30-90 day retention currently under consideration).
- DPA & data residency terms: ZenWell legal prefers explicit retention and deletion SLAs and subprocessor lists.
- Pen test evidence and recent vulnerability scan results required before moving to procurement.

What Redwood can provide (high level)
- SOC 2: We will share the current SOC 2 Type II report once the NDA is completed; we also maintain a controls mapping spreadsheet linking our controls to common frameworks.
- Audit logs: configurable retention windows (default 30 days, options up to 1 year for Dedicated/Private), export via API and scheduled S3 exports.
- DPA: draft attached (Redwood_DPA_draft.pdf) with standard deletion and retention clauses; we can highlight/iterate on any ZenWell-specific requests.
- Pen test summary: we'll attach the latest high-level summary and remediation timeline (pen_test_summary.pdf). Full reports require a controlled-sharing process which we can start once procurement returns the mutual NDA.

Action items & owners
1) Neha: Share SOC 2 questionnaire and controls mapping + draft DPA (attached). (Today EOD)
2) Laura: Confirm if 90-day or 1-year audit-log retention target is preferred and any specific export formats needed (CSV, JSON). (by Fri 5/7)
3) Tom: Procurement will review DPA and confirm NDA path for full artifact sharing (pen test, full SOC 2). (next week)
4) Marissa: Security SME will join follow-up call to walk through controls mapping and evidence access - suggest Wed 5/5 or Thu 5/6.

Attachments (stubs):
- Redwood_DPA_draft.pdf (draft DPA; redlines welcome)
- pen_test_summary.pdf (high-level summary; full report requires NDA)
- ZenWell_SOC2_questions.xlsx (placeholder we'll use to capture mapping)

Next meeting options: Wed 2027-05-05 10:00-10:30 PT or Thu 2027-05-06 15:00-15:30 PT , Marissa will run through the controls mapping. Let me know which works.

Thanks , looking forward to getting you what you need.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Thanks Neha , very helpful recap. Couple quick clarifications: 

1) Retention: Our security policy baseline is 90 days for audit logs, but for vendors storing any telemetry we often require 1 year. Can you confirm whether 1-year retention is available on Hosted API (and any cost delta)?

2) Export: CSV or JSON both fine; we have automation that consumes CSV exports today , S3 export preferred.

3) SOC 2: procurement will need the most recent Type II report PDF. Is that available under a secure link or only via NDA?

We can do Wed 5/5 10:00 PT with Marissa. Tom , can procurement get the NDA started this week?

Laura

Laura / Tom ,

Thanks , quick answers inline and next steps below.

1) Retention / cost: 1-year retention is available on Hosted via our audit-log-tiering add-on (S3 export + archive). Estimated delta: ~0.02 USD per 1K requests + S3 storage costs; for an accurate number I'll pull usage estimates after you confirm expected event volume. If you need guaranteed retention for regulated data, we can recommend Dedicated or Private deployment options with fixed retention SLAs.

2) Export: we'll set up scheduled S3 exports in CSV; format doc will be attached to the Drive link.

3) SOC 2 report: We can share the Type II report PDF via secure link once the mutual NDA is executed. For now I'll attach a controls mapping template (ZenWell_SOC2_questions.xlsx) so you can start mapping items. Full report request: please have procurement/Tom route an NDA to security@redwoodinference.com or use the DocuSign link below.

Attachments included here: ZenWell_SOC2_questions.xlsx, pen_test_summary.pdf, Redwood_DPA_draft.pdf
